title: Sanofi to stop disparaging rival flu vaccine to stave off EU antitrust fine
text: French pharmaceutical company Sanofi has offered to publicly state that a rival flu vaccine, Fluad by CSL Seqirus, is as effective as its own Efluelda vaccine to avoid a potential EU antitrust fine. The EU initiated an investigation into Sanofi for allegedly disparaging Fluad, primarily in France and Germany, which could have restricted competition. Sanofi's proposal includes publishing corrective statements on its French and German websites for two years and refraining from negatively portraying Fluad, implying superior safety or effectiveness of Efluelda, or mischaracterizing scientific studies, with the offer valid until March 2030 if accepted by the EU competition watchdog.

title: Occidental Petroleum Corp. stock underperforms Friday when compared to competitors despite daily gains
text: Shares of Occidental Petroleum Corp. (OXY) rose 1.13% on Friday, closing at $52.89. Despite this daily gain, the stock underperformed compared to the broader market, as the S&P 500 Index and Dow Jones Industrial Average also saw increases. The company's stock finished 21.59% below its 52-week high.

title: Apple Sues OpenAI, Dependence on TSMC, Rise in Prices and More: This Week in Appleverse
text: This article summarizes key Apple-related news from the past week, including Apple's lawsuit against OpenAI for alleged trade secret misuse and the potential for Macs to be Apple's primary AI platform. It also highlights the growing reliance of tech giants like Nvidia and Apple on TSMC for chip manufacturing and how rising prices and profits in the tech sector are driven by increasing demand for AI.

title: Fair Isaac stock reflects steady growth as analytics demand supports the business
text: Fair Isaac Corp. (FICO) stock offers exposure to a leading analytics and decisioning platform, primarily known for its FICO credit scores, which are essential for credit scoring and risk management. The company's business model relies on recurring software and service revenues, with a growing shift towards subscription and cloud-based models. FICO operates with a strong competitive advantage due to the entrenched nature of its credit scores and its expertise in providing trusted analytics solutions to regulated industries.

title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Apple, Tesla and Intel
text: Zacks Investment Ideas highlights Apple, Tesla, and Intel, focusing on Tesla's potential for future growth despite recent stagnation. The article details Tesla's historical stock performance, its latest improvements in delivery numbers, and upcoming catalysts like the Optimus robot, robotaxi service, enhanced FSD capabilities, and the new TeraFab project for semiconductor chip production. It asserts that current lackluster price action for Tesla is a temporary lull before another significant bull run.

title: AI Cost Management: How Prepared Are You?
text: This article addresses the escalating issue of AI spending within organizations, highlighting examples of companies burning through AI budgets rapidly. It outlines five core pillars for effective AI cost management—people, knowledge, visibility, optimization, and operations—to help organizations build a mature FinOps practice for AI. The authors also recommend a maturity assessment and a report for organizations to better manage their AI costs.

title: OmniAb Names Amechi Nwachuku Chief Operating Officer
text: OmniAb, Inc. (NASDAQ:OABI) has appointed Amechi Nwachuku as its new Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer. Nwachuku brings over 25 years of experience in the life sciences industry and will be responsible for managing the strategy, operations, and commercial maximization of OmniAb's xPloration® platform. His appointment aims to strengthen the company's executive team and further drive growth opportunities for its antibody discovery technologies.

title: TotalEnergies: LNG Exposure And AI Power Demand Offer Structural Growth
text: TotalEnergies (TTE) is rated as a "Buy" due to strong financials, robust free cash flow, and a significant cost-saving plan, offering a solid dividend yield and projected total shareholder yield above 7% in 2026. The company is strategically positioned to benefit from long-term energy demand trends through flexible CAPEX, restarted LNG projects, and major power contracts with AI giants like Google. While commodity volatility remains a risk, TTE's strong balance sheet and cost discipline support a favorable risk-reward profile.

title: [424B5] Banzai International, Inc. Prospectus Supplement (Debt Securities)
text: Banzai International, Inc. has filed a prospectus supplement for a primary public offering of Class A Common Stock and pre-funded warrants. The company plans to use the net proceeds, along with existing cash, for working capital and general corporate purposes, including sales, marketing, and product development. Key risks highlighted include historical losses, potential dilution from future financings, and the stock's compliance with Nasdaq listing requirements after multiple reverse stock splits.

title: PLGI ETF Profile: Dividends, Returns (CBOE:PLGI)
text: The article provides a detailed profile of the PL Growth and Income ETF (PLGI), outlining its investment strategy, key statistics, and performance. PLGI aims for growth and income by allocating across equities, fixed income, and options, with primary holdings in US-listed stocks like NVIDIA and Apple. The ETF features an active management style, a 0.45% dividend yield, and a 1.25% expense ratio, with its assets under management currently at $52.22 million.

title: ExxonMobil’s $100 Billion Cash Flow Story Isn’t Over Yet
text: ExxonMobil generated over $100 billion in operating cash flow across fiscals 2024 and 2025, enabling significant dividends and share buybacks. The company's growth strategy focuses on advantaged assets like the Permian and Guyana, and its Golden Pass LNG project is set to boost US LNG exports significantly. With a strong balance sheet and a 3% dividend yield backed by 43 years of growth, XOM continues to be a compelling stock for long-term, retirement-focused investors.

title: Erasca Announces Pricing of Upsized Public Offering of Common Stock
text: Erasca, Inc. (Nasdaq: ERAS) has announced the pricing of an upsized public offering of 31,428,572 shares of its common stock at $17.50 per share, expecting gross proceeds of approximately $550.0 million. The clinical-stage oncology company plans to use these proceeds, along with existing cash, to fund research and development of its product candidates and for general corporate purposes. J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, Jefferies, and Evercore ISI are acting as joint book-running managers for the offering, which is expected to close on July 15, 2026.

title: Citigroup Adjusts Price Target on Phillips 66 to $204 From $183, Maintains Neutral Rating
text: Citigroup has increased its price target for Phillips 66 (PSX) to $204 from $183, while keeping a Neutral rating on the stock. This adjustment reflects an updated outlook on the oil and gas refining and marketing company. Several other analysts also recently updated their price targets for Phillips 66, with most maintaining an "Outperform" or "Buy" rating.

title: ADOCIA Announces the Expiration of Exclusive Right to Negotiate Partnership for M1Pram with SANOFI
text: Adocia announced the expiration of Sanofi's three-year exclusive right to negotiate a partnership for M1Pram, a fixed combination of insulin and amylin analogs for type 1 diabetes. Adocia retains global rights to M1Pram but has put its development on hold to focus on metabolic peptide delivery platforms despite positive Phase 2a trial results. The company will continue to evaluate M1Pram's future as the type 1 diabetes treatment landscape evolves, especially given the rise of GLP-1 therapies.

text: This article provides a comprehensive profile of the Baron First Principles ETF (RONB), detailing its investment strategy, holdings, and financial performance. It highlights that RONB aims for long-term growth by investing in US companies based on fundamental research and may borrow up to one-third of its assets. title: Hsbc Holdings PLC Buys Shares of 44,800 WesBanco, Inc. $WSBC
text: HSBC Holdings PLC has acquired a new stake of 44,800 shares in WesBanco, Inc. (NASDAQ:WSBC) during the fourth quarter, valued at approximately $1.49 million. This purchase adds to significant institutional ownership, with major firms like Vanguard and State Street also holding large positions. WesBanco has received a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts, recently exceeded EPS estimates, and offers a quarterly dividend yielding about 3.9%, alongside a 4 million-share buyback authorization.

title: What are Honda's Top Indirect Suppliers in North America?
text: Honda recently honored over 30 indirect suppliers, including AWS, IBM, and Microsoft, at its annual Indirect Procurement Supplier Conference for their contributions to innovation, sustainability, and efficiency in procurement. In 2025, Honda sourced over $7 billion in materials and services from more than 5,600 North American suppliers. The company highlighted specific collaborations, such as AWS providing technological infrastructure for data management and IBM improving efficiency through AI-driven knowledge extraction.

title: What is next for commodities?
text: Commodity prices have cooled since mid-May highs, but they remain a valuable asset class due to their diversification benefits, inflation sensitivity, and exposure to structural demand trends. Despite recent pullbacks in oil and gold, underlying support for commodities persists through factors like thin inventories, central bank demand, and needs from AI, electrification, and climate change. UBS recommends a broad, actively managed approach to commodity exposure, especially given their low correlation with equities and bonds.

title: Honeywell (HON) Stock Looks Undervalued After Fresh AI Automation News
text: Honeywell International's stock has seen a significant pullback of 48.6% recently, prompting a re-evaluation of its potential. Despite appearing undervalued on certain metrics and implementing new initiatives like AI-driven platforms, broader valuation checks suggest it's not a straightforward bargain. The market is currently weighing execution risks associated with portfolio changes and financial leverage against the company's growth opportunities.

title: Can American Tower (NYSE:AMT) Regain Market Momentum?
text: American Tower (NYSE:AMT) is facing challenges from slower carrier spending and higher borrowing costs, which have impacted its market performance. Despite these headwinds, the company's long-term tower model is supported by dependable leases and increasing demand for wireless data. Improving the outlook for American Tower would likely require stronger carrier budgets, lower funding costs, and a greater need for network capacity.

title: Sanofi eyes extending Nexviazyme into infantile Pompe
text: Sanofi is preparing to expand the use of its Pompe therapy, Nexviazyme, to include patients diagnosed in infancy, following positive results from the phase 3 Baby-COMET study. Currently, Nexviazyme is approved for late-onset Pompe in some markets, but the new data supports regulatory filings to extend its label in the US before year-end for infantile-onset cases. This expansion is crucial as infantile-onset Pompe is the most severe form of the disease, and Nexviazyme, which offers enhanced enzyme uptake and glycogen clearance compared to older treatments, could provide a much-needed therapeutic option for these young patients.

title: WOK Stock Holds Range As Traders Track Key Levels
text: WORK Medical Technology Group LTD (WOK) stock is holding a trading range, showing an 8.91% increase due to promising medical technology expansion news. Traders are monitoring key levels, particularly support at $2.00 and resistance at $2.60, as the stock displays high intraday volatility with aggressive swings. The company shows a compressed valuation and a solid balance sheet, but weak profitability, making it a speculative, short-term trading opportunity driven by technicals rather than fundamentals.

title: JNJ Stock Keeps Climbing. Should You Climb On?
text: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) stock has surged over 71% in the past year, outperforming the S&P 500, driven by strong operating margins, revenue growth, and a promising pipeline of new drugs like ICOTYDE. However, its premium valuation, evidenced by high P/E and P/S ratios, and some weakness in its MedTech division, particularly the Surgery business, suggest that the current price might already factor in much of its future success. The key for continued growth will be the rapid market adoption and revenue generation from new products to offset challenges like biosimilar competition for established blockbusters like STELARA.

title: Sanofi Probed by EU Over Flu Vaccine Marketing
text: The European Union has launched an antitrust investigation into French drugmaker Sanofi concerning its marketing campaign for the Efluelda flu vaccine. The probe aims to determine if Sanofi's promotional activities for Efluelda represent anticompetitive disparagement of a rival vaccine produced by CSL Seqirus. Sanofi has stated its confidence in its compliance with all applicable laws and competition rules.

title: Absher Wealth Management LLC Sells 32,137 Shares of Walmart Inc. $WMT
text: Absher Wealth Management LLC significantly reduced its stake in Walmart Inc. by selling 32,137 shares, decreasing its position by 12% in the first quarter, though Walmart remains a substantial holding valued at approximately $29.2 million. This comes as Walmart reported strong quarterly results, with revenue surpassing expectations and earnings matching estimates. Despite the sell-off by Absher, analysts largely maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for WMT, citing its defensive attributes and growth potential from initiatives like Walmart+.

title: Banzai International, Inc. Announces Pricing of $0.9 Million Underwritten Public Offering
text: Banzai International, Inc. (NASDAQ: BNZI) has priced an underwritten public offering of 327,273 shares of Class A common stock at $2.75 per share, expecting to raise approximately $0.9 million in gross proceeds. The company plans to use the net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes. Aegis Capital Corp. is acting as Sole Bookrunner for the offering, which is expected to close around July 14, 2026.

title: Lifeworks Advisors LLC Purchases New Holdings in VeriSign, Inc. $VRSN
text: Lifeworks Advisors LLC initiated a new position in VeriSign, Inc. (VRSN) during the first quarter, acquiring 11,117 shares valued at approximately $2.76 million. The company reported strong Q1 earnings, surpassing analyst expectations with an EPS of $2.34 and revenue of $428.9 million, indicating a 6.6% year-over-year increase. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating with an average price target of $327.67 for VeriSign.

title: GSPY ETF Profile: Dividends, Returns (BOATS:GSPY)
text: This article provides a detailed profile of the Gotham Enhanced 500 ETF (GSPY), an actively managed ETF that invests in S&P 500 components based on perceived under or overvaluation. The fund's holdings are primarily in electronic technology and technology services, with most assets located in North America.

title: Eni CEO warns prolonged Middle East conflict could push oil prices higher (E:NYSE)
text: Eni CEO Claudio Descalzi stated that a prolonged conflict in the Middle East could significantly drive up oil prices beyond their current range by early 2027. This increase would likely fuel inflation and negatively impact global energy demand. Descalzi's comments highlight concerns about the economic repercussions of ongoing instability in the region.

text:
Exhibit 99.1

Microsoft announces appointment of Carmine Di Sibio to board of directors

REDMOND, Wash. — May 14, 2026 — Microsoft Corp. on Thursday announced the appointment of Carmine Di Sibio, former global
chairman and CEO of EY, to the Microsoft board of directors. He will serve on both the Compensation Committee and Audit Committee, bringing
expertise in financial services, risk oversight and global client leadership to meet the evolving needs of
our customers while advancing Microsoft’s mission to empower every person and organization to achieve more. With Di Sibio’s appointment, the
Microsoft board of directors has been expanded to 13 members.

“Our board will immediately benefit from Carmine’s deep financial expertise, global lens and decades of advising organizations
through real complexity,” said Sandra Peterson, Microsoft lead independent director. “His addition strengthens the board, and we look forward
to working with him.”

“Carmine has spent four decades advising some of the world’s most complex organizations on strategy, financial risk and global
growth,” said Satya Nadella, chairman and CEO, Microsoft. “That depth of experience will strengthen our board as we work to deliver on our
mission and meet the evolving needs of our customers.”

Di Sibio joined EY in 1985, leading to a four-decade career at the company. Before becoming the CEO and global chairman of EY, Di Sibio held
various leadership positions including the global managing partner in Client Services, leading the execution of the organization’s global
strategy, as well as the chair of the Global Financial Services Markets and the regional managing partner
for the Americas Financial Services Organization (FSO). He brings decades of global leadership experience advising leading companies on
strategy and risk management.

Di Sibio holds a Bachelor of Arts in chemistry from Colgate University and an MBA from New
York University’s Stern School of Business. He is also an independent director on the boards of PayPal Holdings, Inc., Prudential Financial,
Inc. and Evolver, in addition to board member positions at Hackensack Meridien Hospital, Colgate
University and Wake Forest University Business School.
